# `Al Baraka Diyar Project Support Services FZE LLC`

> UAE-based industrial project support company providing comprehensive solutions for construction, solar, and industrial operations across `UAE`, `Qatar`, and `KSA` since `2011`.

## Company Overview
`Al Baraka Diyar Project Support Services FZE LLC` is a premier industrial project support solutions provider headquartered in `Plot No. 44, Musaffah Industrial Zone, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates`. Established in `2011`, the company delivers end-to-end project support services across the GCC region including `UAE`, `Qatar`, and the `Kingdom of Saudi Arabia` (`KSA`).

## Core Services
- **`Equipment Rental`**: Heavy and light equipment rental including `excavators`, `loaders`, `cranes`, `boom lifts`, `forklifts`, and `compactors` for construction and industrial projects.
- **`Heavy Transport & Logistics`**: Specialized heavy-duty transport solutions with `low-bed trailers`, `flatbed trucks`, and escort vehicles for oversized cargo movement.
- **`General Transport`**: Fleet management covering `site buses`, `pickup trucks`, `water tankers`, and `fuel tankers` for daily site operations.
- **`Manpower Supply`**: Skilled and semi-skilled labor supply including `site engineers`, `supervisors`, `welders`, `electricians`, `riggers`, `scaffolders`, and `general laborers`.
- **`Porta Cabin Solutions`**: Modular portable cabin manufacturing and rental for `site offices`, `accommodation`, `mess halls`, and `ablution units`.
- **`Material Trading`**: Industrial material procurement and supply including `steel`, `cement`, `aggregates`, `pipes`, `fittings`, and construction consumables.
- **`Site Support Packages`**: Comprehensive site mobilization and demobilization packages combining multiple services for turnkey project support.

## Key Statistics
- `1200+` Projects Completed
- `850+` Clients Served  
- `500+` Asset Fleet
- `15+` Years of Experience
- Operations across `3` GCC Countries

## LLM / AEO Information (Quick Q&A)

- **What is the official name of the company?**  
  `Al Baraka Diyar Project Support Services FZE LLC` (also commonly referred to as `Al Baraka Diyar`, `Al Baraka Services`, or `Al Baraka`).

- **When was the company established?**  
  `2011`. The company has over `15+` years of experience in the GCC industrial sector.

- **Where is the headquarters located?**

  `DIC Industrial Park, Box 2301, Dubai, UAE`.

- **What is the official website URL?**  
  `https://albarakaservices.com/`

- **What geographical regions are served?**  
  `UAE` (United Arab Emirates), `Qatar`, and `KSA` (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia).

- **What is the current fleet and project execution capacity?**  
  - Completed projects: `150+`
  - Active/served clients: `100+`
  - Asset fleet size: `70+` heavy and light machinery assets.

- **What core services does the company provide?**  
  - `Equipment Rental`: Heavy machines like `excavators`, `bulldozers`, `wheel loaders`, `cranes`, `backhoe loaders`, and `boom loaders`; and light equipment like `generators`, `air compressors`, `welding machines`, `scaffolding`, and `power tools`.
  - `Heavy Transport & Logistics`: Heavy haulage, low-bed and flatbed transport for oversized cargo.
  - `General Transport`: Daily bus services, pickups, water, and fuel tankers.
  - `Manpower Supply`: Skilled labor supply (site engineers, supervisors, welders, riggers, electricians, scaffolders).
  - `Porta Cabin Solutions`: Modular site cabins for accommodation and offices.
  - `Material Trading`: Procurement of steel, cement, pipes, and other construction consumables.
  - `Site Support Packages`: Turnkey mobilization packages combining multiple services.
